P.name: Adaptive Defenses
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Camille's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} against an enemy champion grants her a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|10 to 25 for 4|1 to 19}} of her '''maximum''' health}}}}, lasting for 2 seconds and absorbing damage from either exclusively {{tip|physical damage|{{as|physical damage}}}} or {{tip|magic damage|{{as|magic damage}}}}, based on which type the target has previously dealt most of against champions as well as on '''Camille's''' '''current''' {{sti|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|magic resistance}}}}.

Q.name: Precision Protocol
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Camille''' empowers her next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and grant her {{as|{{sti|movement speed|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second. This attack cannot {{tip|critically strike}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|20 to 40}}% AD}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|25 to 45}}%}}
Q.description2: After {{fd|0.25}} seconds of using the empowered attack, ''Precision Protocol'' can then be recast within the next {{fd|3.5}} seconds at no additional cost.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Camille''' mimics the first cast's effects. If ''Precision Protocol'' is recast after {{fd|1.5}} seconds of the first attack, then the '''bonus''' damage is doubled, and {{pp|key=%|40 to 100 for 16|formula=36%+(4%*level). ''Capped at level 16''}} of the attack's '''total''' damage will be dealt as {{as|{{sti|true damage}}}}.
Q.description4: ''Both casts of Precision Protocol {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} '''Camille's''' basic attack timer. '''Camille''' is able to cast {{ai|Tactical Sweep|Camille}}, {{ai|Hookshot|Camille}}, or {{ai|The Hextech Ultimatum|Camille}} during the windup of Precision Protocol's empowered attack without cancelling it.''

W.name: Tactical Sweep
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Camille''' sweeps her leg in a cone in the target direction over {{fd|1.1}} seconds, during which she is {{tip|ghosted}} and unable to declare basic attacks. Afterwards, she deals {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies within.
W.description2: Enemies hit by the outer half of the cone take {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}, capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}, and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 80% decaying over 2 seconds. '''Camille''' is {{tip|healing|healed}} for 100% of this '''additional''' damage {{tt|post-mitigation|After modifiers such as resistances}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} in the outer half.
W.leveling2: {{st|Outer Cone Additional Damage|{{as|{{ap|7 to 9}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
W.description3: Non-epic monsters take 50% damage from ''Tactical Sweep''.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Non-Epic Monster Damage|{{ap|60/2 to 160/2}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Non-Epic Monster Damage|{{as|{{ap|7/2 to 9/2}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.25}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
W.description4: ''Other abilities can be cast during the animation without cancelling it.''

E.name: Hookshot
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Camille''' fires a grapple in the target direction. If the grapple collides with terrain, '''Camille''' will {{tip|dash}} toward and attach to the terrain for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, during which she gains the ability to cast ''{{ai|Wall Dive|Camille}}''.
E.description2: '''''Camille''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
E.description3: ''Other abilities can be cast during the ability. Casting {{ai|The Hextech Ultimatum|Camille}} will cause the grapple to disappear if it is in flight.''

E.name: Wall Dive
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Camille''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies near the landing location. ''Wall Dive's'' range is doubled towards enemy {{tip|champions}} within 1400 units. '''Camille''' grants {{tip|ghosted|ghosting}} to non-champions she passes through for 4 seconds. After dashing, '''Camillle''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.
E.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}
E.description2: '''Camille''' stops prematurely upon colliding with an enemy champion, {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} all nearby enemy champions, though not through terrain, as well as {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
E.description3: ''Wall Dive may be also cast with movement or attack commands. Other abilities besides {{ai|The Hextech Ultimatum|Camille}} can be cast while grappled or during the dash.''

R.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Camille''' becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|dash|leaps}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} towards the target enemy {{tip|champion|champion}} over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for the duration and {{tip|disrupt|disrupting}} their ongoing {{tip|channel|channels}}.
R.description2: Upon landing on the target, she becomes targetable again and creates a hexagonal zone around her current location for a duration, {{tip|airborne|knocking away}} all other nearby enemies on impact to the edge of the zone, though not through terrain.
R.description3: The target cannot escape the zone through any means. While within the zone, '''Camille's''' basic attacks against the target deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
R.leveling3: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|4 to 8}}% of target's '''current''' health}}}}
R.description4: ''The Hextech Ultimatum'' ends automatically within 1 second if '''Camille''' leaves the area or dies.
